intro: Technology and cloud infrastructure sectors were most affected by Kubernetes vulnerabilities tracked between 2026-04-15 and 2026-09-30, a span covering five articles. CVE-2026-42880 carried a CVSS score of 9.6, while CVE-2026-33413 and CVE-2026-6389 each scored 8.8. Cloud-services, finance, and government organizations were also affected, with impact recorded globally. The severity mix across the period comprised two high and two critical ratings.
